segments.name: Integrated Manufacturing Solutions ("IMS")
products: printed circuit board ("PCB") assembly and test
segments.evidence: IMS is a single operating segment consisting of printed circuit board ("PCB") assembly and test, high-level assembly and test and direct order fulfillment.

revenueModel.text: Sanmina earns revenue primarily from sales of manufactured products and services to OEM customers, typically under long-term supply agreements of three to five years covering products made to customers' specifications.
revenueModel.evidence: We typically enter into long-term supply agreements with our major OEM customers.

changes.text: In October 2025, after fiscal 2025 year end, Sanmina completed the acquisition of ZT Systems' data center infrastructure manufacturing business to expand its cloud and AI presence.
changes.evidence: On October 27, 2025 (the "Closing Date"), we completed the acquisition of ZT Systems (the "ZT Acquisition") for an aggregate consideration of $1.6 billion
